text: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 是 DSH Web 插件：将注册的 slot 树挂载为原生 Custom Elements。webComponent 服务读取 slots，将 root slot 装入 Element 或 ShadowRoot，并支持属性、事件和子 outlet 绑定。它按 slot 与会话状态选择条目、转发 CustomEvent、清理挂载树，并为失败条目显示诊断元素。适合已有兼容 DSH Web runtime、希望用原生元素构建界面的 profile；bundle 行默认禁用，启用前需提供浏览器 DOM 与 slots 服务。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component mounts DSH slots as native Custom Elements. Its service mounts the root into an Element or ShadowRoot, binds properties and events, and manages child outlets. It requires browser DOM APIs and the slots service; profiles explicitly enable its bundle row.
想把 DSH 的 slot 界面用浏览器原生自定义元素显示。
有没有办法将 DSH 注册的界面组件挂到 ShadowRoot 里？
让 DSH Web profile 可以用 Custom Element 来渲染 slot 树。
我想让自定义元素接收 DSH 的状态属性，并把事件回传给动作处理器。
DSH 的 slot 子界面能否挂到父自定义元素提供的 outlet？
希望会话切换时，浏览器界面能按 slot 生命周期更新元素实例。
How can I render DSH slot interfaces as native custom elements in a browser?
I need DSH state and actions bound to properties and events on browser elements.
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 的功能「掛载根 slot」：调用 mountRoot 将 root 树装入 Element 或 ShadowRoot，并可更新或销毁挂载。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 的功能「属性事件绑定」：把 DSH 值写入元素属性，并将声明的 CustomEvent detail 转交回调。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 的功能「子 slot outlet」：解析父元素声明的 DOM outlet，并在其中挂载对应子 slot。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 的功能「失败诊断」：条目处理失败时以诊断元素替换，并记录错误信息。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 须知：bundle 行默认禁用，profile 需提供 slots host 和 browser runtime（见 cordis.patch.yml:1-8）。
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component 使用前须知：浏览器标签定义不能注销或替换；更换 constructor 后需刷新页面（见 src/client/registry.ts:58-75）。

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component`：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

The DSH Web Component adapter as an installable profile bundle. It exposes a browser-side `webComponent` service that mounts registered slot trees as native Custom Elements, while keeping slot ownership, typed descriptors, property/event bindings, DOM outlets, and incarnation lifetimes behind the adapter boundary.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Repository shape：```text
package.json              # plugin package and dsh.bundle/dshClient manifests
cordis.patch.yml          # browser opt-in profile layer
src/index.ts              # host loader entry
src/client/               # browser implementation

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Bundle behavior：Installing the bundle adds a disabled `web-component` row. A Web profile enables it explicitly after the slot host and browser runtime are present:

```yaml
- id: web-component
  disabled: false
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component'
```

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Bundle behavior：The bundle layer only composes the plugin row. Slot host APIs, descriptor types, browser runtime, and the React renderer seam must come from the DSH version selected by the profile. The previous host-source integration patch is retained under `legacy/` for migration of older DSH snapshots and is not part of the bundle package contract.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Bundle behavior：The client module never exposes a live React tree or raw DOM context to feature plugins. It accepts plain descriptors, resolves declared values from the incarnation context, assigns JavaScript properties rather than serialized attributes, and reports CustomEvent details through declared handlers.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Development：A full typecheck expects a sibling DSH checkout:

```text
~/git/deepseek-harness
~/git/web-components
```

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test
pnpm run build

The `prepare` script builds the host and browser entries directly from `src/`, so a Git install does not require sibling project references. pnpm 10 may ask the profile to allow the package's prepare script; only approve a pinned, trusted checkout.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-web-component README · Model Experience：This package contributes no model-visible text, tools, or prompt sections. It only projects browser slot state and Custom Element events; model-visible behavior remains owned by the DSH services rendered through the slots.
